method: Each check is an MCP initialize + tools/list from Faceabot (User-Agent FaceabotProbe/1.0) plus, when the server declares a read-only tool (readOnlyHint), one call of that tool with a neutral sample input to check it really returns a result. reliable = ≥95% success over ≥3 checks with ≥3 consecutive successes; requires_authentication = private server, not counted as a failure.
scope: Sample: the 100 best-proven servers. The full database is not downloadable; look up any single server with /api/reliability?url=… or the MCP tool check_reliability.
